activationDateFrom.description: The earliest date the insurance is estimated to start.

insuranceCoverages.description: The coverages that may be selected with prices

links.description: Link to terms or detailed information.

isSelected.description: Is this the coverage selected for this quote. Unless explicitly changed the default suggestion coverage will be the selected one.

isDefaultSuggestion.description: Is this the coverage that was selected by default for this quote.

insuranceBrand.description: The brand of the insurance. Default is "If", but branded insurances may give other branding names.

coverageName.description: A name that describes the given coverage.

coverageItemsIncluded.description:
The identifiers of the coverage items which are included in this coverage. 
An insurance coverage will be made up of a set of coverage items, and a given coverage item may be in several coverages. 
One item can for instance describe glass coverage, or fire coverage etc. More information about the coverage item can be fetched from 
https://api.if-insurance.com/test/list-coverage-items-travel-insurance-fi/v1/coverage-items
